source_description: User-provided four-expert compilation; contains unverified vendor/version/tool-count and performance claims; not proof Hollywood studios universally deploy this precise multi-agent topology.
production_core_thesis: Not models replacing artists: orchestrate versioned shot/assets across safe DCC executors, evidence-backed research, independent objective/art QC, RCA and human release approval.

stages.gate: Complete authorized original video and sound for each chosen competitor source before deriving methods.
Approved original script/shotlist with cause-effect, audio and camera coverage.
Version all original cast, texture, rig, world, scene and dependent edits with exact hashes and export formats.
Run allowed local scene owner-worker with source/provenance, log/frame and no spending.
Same original asset and full camera sequence roundtrip, report transformations lost.
Validate actual 1080p/4K full audio/video master and transcode/frame/color reports.
Evidence-backed independent scene approval, root-cause fix, safe rerender and no false release approval.
Final movie, license and original asset/VO rights, human approved upload.

technologies.name: Planner → Executor → Critic + human approval
technologies.next_gate: Test an actual scene from approved research to finished video/audio through signed QC return loop.
